SPIREMAP.panel.title: Spire Map — Map Generator
SPIREMAP.fields.bossEnabled: Add a boss floor on top
SPIREMAP.fields.firstFloorFixed: First floor always uses one type
SPIREMAP.fields.forceReachableExit: Guarantee every node has an entry and an exit
SPIREMAP.fields.noSameTypeAsSoleParent: A node with a single parent never repeats its type
SPIREMAP.fields.noRepeatOnPath: Never twice in a row on a path
SPIREMAP.fields.clearPrevious: Erase the module's previous map first
SPIREMAP.fields.createNotes: Create a map note on every node
SPIREMAP.fields.createJournal: Create one journal entry per node
SPIREMAP.hints.seed: The same seed always produces the same map. Write it down to reproduce it later.
SPIREMAP.hints.floors: Number of floors before the boss.
SPIREMAP.hints.paths: How many routes climb the spire. More paths means a denser map.
SPIREMAP.hints.columns: Grid width. The original game uses 7.
SPIREMAP.hints.preventCrossing: The most important visual rule of the original map: two paths never cross.
SPIREMAP.hints.preventSmallLoops: Stops two paths from splitting and merging again immediately.
SPIREMAP.hints.forceReachableExit: Prunes dead ends and orphan nodes after generation.
SPIREMAP.hints.noSameTypeAsSoleParent: Avoids two identical rooms in a row when there is no choice.
SPIREMAP.hints.types: Tune the weights to change how often each room shows up. Weight 0 never appears. Icons accept any image in your data folder.
SPIREMAP.hints.title: Use {act} and {seed} as placeholders.
SPIREMAP.preview.clickHint: Click a node in the preview to change its type by hand.
SPIREMAP.notify.gmOnly: Only the GM can draw the map on a scene.
SPIREMAP.notify.noActiveScene: No active scene. Activate one or pick "Create a new scene".
SPIREMAP.notify.confirmClear: Remove every element generated by Spire Map on "{scene}"?
SPIREMAP.notify.confirmResetTypes: Restore the seven default types? Your edits to the types will be lost.
SPIREMAP.notify.confirmResetAll: Reset the whole configuration to its default values?
SPIREMAP.notify.defaultsSaved: Configuration saved as the world default.
SPIREMAP.notify.needOneType: At least one node type must remain.
SPIREMAP.notify.importHint: Paste the JSON you exported earlier.
SPIREMAP.chat.title: New map generated
SPIREMAP.journal.placeholder: Write the contents of this encounter here.
SPIREMAP.settings.showSceneButton.name: Toolbar button
SPIREMAP.settings.showSceneButton.hint: Shows the panel button in the scene controls (requires a reload).
SPIREMAP.settings.autoPreview.name: Automatic preview
SPIREMAP.settings.autoPreview.hint: Refreshes the preview on every change in the panel.
SPIREMAP.settings.openPanel.name: Generator panel
SPIREMAP.settings.openPanel.label: Open panel
SPIREMAP.settings.openPanel.hint: Opens the map configuration and generation panel.
SPIREMAP.fields.revealModeOnChoice: Automatic, driven by the party's choice
SPIREMAP.fields.revealFirstFloor: Reveal the first floor's options at the start
SPIREMAP.fields.hideEdgesUntilRevealed: Hide the paths too until revealed
SPIREMAP.fields.announceReveal: Announce every party move in chat
SPIREMAP.fields.showPartyMarker: Show a ring on the party's position
SPIREMAP.hints.secretNodes: Players see the map's structure, but every room shows up as a neutral "?" node. Labels, icons and notes of hidden nodes are invisible to them too.
SPIREMAP.hints.revealLookahead: 0 = players only learn a room after entering it. 1 = the immediate options are visible (recommended). 2 or more = they see further ahead.
SPIREMAP.hints.hideEdges: By default the paths stay visible (like the original game) and only the room contents are secret.
SPIREMAP.hints.tracker: In the reveal tracker you mark the room the players chose and the map opens up as they climb.
SPIREMAP.reveal.title: Spire Map — Reveal Tracker
SPIREMAP.reveal.noMap: No Spire Map on this scene.
SPIREMAP.reveal.noMapHint: Generate a map from the panel to control the reveal. Current scene:
SPIREMAP.reveal.secretOff: This map was drawn with secrecy off: every node is already visible to the players.
SPIREMAP.reveal.optionsHint: Click the room the players picked.
SPIREMAP.reveal.noOptions: No options from here — the party reached the top.
SPIREMAP.reveal.forceHint: Moves the party to this node even if it is not a valid option.
SPIREMAP.reveal.stepBackHint: Moves the party back one step. Whatever was revealed stays revealed.
SPIREMAP.reveal.confirmReset: Send the party back to the start and hide everything again?
SPIREMAP.reveal.resync: Re-apply the state to the scene
SPIREMAP.reveal.notStarted: The party has not entered the spire yet — pick a room on the first floor.
SPIREMAP.reveal.mapHint: Click a room with a dashed ring to mark it as chosen. Click any other to select it. Ctrl/Shift + wheel = zoom.
SPIREMAP.reveal.error.notAvailable: That node is not an option from the current position. Use "Move here" to force it.
SPIREMAP.reveal.error.unknownNode: Node not found in this map.
SPIREMAP.reveal.error.noMap: No Spire Map on this scene.
